item.title: Compact controlled Whitney spaces admit compatible finite triangulations
item.statement: Assume AC. A compact finite controlled Whitney-stratified subset of a smooth ambient space admits a finite triangulation of dimension at most the largest real stratum dimension, compatible with every stratum closure and any prescribed union of strata. Each open stratum is a union of open simplices. The homeomorphism is smooth on the pieces within each stratum. The construction may make the finitely many normal link-bundle projections between triangulated compact stratum cores piecewise linear. It does not make an arbitrary algebraic map globally simplicial. In particular it applies individually to compactifications of quasi-projective complex varieties and to their compact controlled links, once the stated Whitney/control hypotheses have been supplied.
item.strategy: Use the normalized commuting radial collars of [[lem-compact-controlled-whitney-spaces-admit-commuting-radial-collars]]. For a stratum $X$ and level $a$, the closure of the level set meets only incident upper strata and lower frontier strata and is a compact controlled space of strictly smaller dimension; inherited projections are submersive on its strata, its cores (strata with lower tubes removed) are compact smooth manifolds with corners whose active radius functions have independent differentials, and the core-to-base maps are proper corner submersions with compatible faces ([[thm-constant-rank-theorem-for-manifolds]]; local constructions use [[thm-smooth-partitions-of-unity-exist-on-manifolds]], [[thm-smooth-dependence-of-ode-solutions-on-parameters]] and AC through [[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]] and [[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Flow the coordinate fields of the corner charts to obtain genuine finite smooth bundle product charts, supplying the hypotheses of the relative manifold and bundle triangulation suppliers [[thm-compact-smooth-manifolds-with-corners-admit-relative-finite-triangulations]], [[thm-smooth-bundles-admit-relative-finite-triangulations-over-a-fixed-base-triangulation]] and the projection-preserving fitting supplier [[lem-relative-smooth-triangulations-can-be-fitted-while-preserving-a-bundle-projection]]. Induct on dimension with partial triangulations $C_{(n,p)}$ of top boundaries controlled by $p$-dimensional lower strata and interior triangulations $B_n$, retaining buffers and using subcomplex-compatibility given by the radial collars; finally attach each stratum collar by the explicit mapping cylinder [[lem-finite-simplicial-maps-have-explicit-compatible-triangulated-mapping-cylinders]], whose endpoints and subcylinder behaviour match the marked level complexes. Finitely many $(n,p)$ assertions and finitely many parameter decreases leave a positive final radius.
item.axiom_use: AC is assumed and used through AC => DC => AC_omega ([[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]]) for the partition-of-unity and ODE suppliers and the inherited collar construction ([[thm-smooth-partitions-of-unity-exist-on-manifolds]], [[def-axiom-of-choice]]). The triangulation inductions are finite.

references.title: R. M. Goresky, Triangulation of stratified objects, sections 2-4, printed pp. 193-199

item.title: Algebraically constructible sheaves have finite compatible stratified and local cochain models
item.statement:
Assume AC. Let $X$ be a quasi-projective complex algebraic variety, $k$ a field, and $F$ a bounded complex of analytic $k$-sheaves whose cohomology is locally constant of finite rank on a finite complex algebraic stratification. Fix finitely many algebraic supports and locally closed inclusions to be respected. There is a finite compatible smooth complex algebraic Whitney refinement, a projective compactification with its algebraic boundary respected, and a finite pair of simplicial complexes $(K,D)$ such that $X^{\mathrm{an}}\cong|K|\setminus|D|$, every open simplex lies in one complex stratum, and the marked supports are unions of simplices. One can take $\dim K\le2\dim_{\mathbb C}X$; in particular constant-sheaf cohomology vanishes above that real dimension. The same construction applies individually to the compact controlled links supplied by the conical-neighbourhood theorem.

On these models, actual ordinary and compact-support cohomology, ordinary derived Hom, internal derived Hom and local cohomology with a prescribed algebraic support have bounded finite-dimensional cochain models. Internal Hom is constructible on a finite complex Whitney refinement. The local link and support models vary locally constantly along the corresponding complex strata; thus their cohomology has finite rank there. Every such model commutes with extension of the coefficient field. Inclusions and supports are chosen in finite collections for a given construction; no compatible triangulation of arbitrary algebraic maps or cyclic diagrams is asserted. Perverse dimensions remain the dimensions of the complex strata, independent of the auxiliary real simplices.
item.strategy: Choose a projective closure $\overline X$ of $X$ and apply the compatible Whitney stratification construction [[thm-algebraic-whitney-strata-have-controlled-local-conical-neighborhoods]] (including its upstream algebraic stratification input), also respecting the boundary $B=\overline X\setminus X$ and the closures of the marked supports and stratal pieces. Embed $\overline X^{\mathrm{an}}$ smoothly in Euclidean space by the Hermitian rank-one projector $z\mapsto zz^*/\|z\|^2$ and triangulate the resulting compact controlled Whitney space by [[lem-compact-semialgebraic-families-admit-compatible-finite-triangulations]], taking $D$ the subcomplex mapping onto $B$ and refining so all marked subsets are full subcomplexes; open simplices refine the complex strata and $\dim K\le2\dim_{\mathbb C}X$. On the retained simplices the finite-rank locally constant cohomology of $F$ lies in the essential image of the incidence model [[lem-finite-simplicial-constructible-sheaves-have-a-derived-incidence-model]], and the finite strict-face-chain bar resolutions [[lem-finite-poset-diagrams-have-bounded-finite-bar-models]] compute its ordinary and derived Hom with bounded finite-dimensional complexes. Compact-support and local statements use the open/closed support triangles of that model and the explicit finite star/cone models of [[lem-finite-simplicial-open-stars-have-explicit-conical-product-charts]]. Local constancy along a complex stratum follows from the conical chart $U\cong V\times cL$ of the neighbourhood theorem: on the contractible factor the pullback from the link is fully faithful, and the finite filtration of the link simplicial skeleta expresses the object by a finite coefficient complex. Field-extension compatibility reduces to the finite local-system comparison [[lem-finite-cell-local-system-cohomology-is-finite-and-commutes-with-field-extension]] and exactness of tensor product. AC is inherited exactly from the tube/partition and analytic derived-sheaf suppliers ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]); all displayed matrix operations are finite.
item.axiom_use: AC is assumed and consumed through [[lem-compact-semialgebraic-families-admit-compatible-finite-triangulations]], [[thm-algebraic-whitney-strata-have-controlled-local-conical-neighborhoods]], [[lem-finite-simplicial-constructible-sheaves-have-a-derived-incidence-model]] and [[def-axiom-of-choice]]; the final cochain computations are finite.

references.title: Mark Goresky, Triangulation of stratified objects, sections 3-4 (triangulation of Whitney-stratified sets)
Mark Goresky, Lecture Notes on Sheaves and Perverse Sheaves, version of June 26, 2026; Sections 9.1-9.4 (constructible sheaves and finite hypercohomology)
